question: To whom should the kaula essence be given, and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: This practice of the soul is told to you.
It is also told to you, O Bhairavi.
inference: The teaching has been communicated to the disciple.
uncertainties: etat may refer to preceding practice.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavi.
